name: Link
summary: Native anchor primitive with destination, visible label, current-page semantics, direct target and relationship attributes, three visual variants, and canonical hover and focus-visible states.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default link size inherited from surrounding text.

behavior.name: navigation
behavior.description: Links use native anchors with href for navigation. Target, relationship, and current-page metadata remain native anchor attributes; actions use Button.

behavior.name: motionPreference
behavior.description: Color and decoration transitions are removed when the user requests reduced motion without changing native navigation behavior.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Long unbroken labels may wrap at arbitrary points instead of forcing horizontal overflow in a narrow container.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible link text that communicates the destination when read outside its surrounding sentence.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Native navigation destination. Link requires href; use Button when activation does not navigate.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual treatment selected from Default, Subtle, or Nav; Default is classless.

properties.name: target
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit target and use the current browsing context.
properties.description: Optional native anchor target such as _blank or the name of a browsing context.

properties.name: rel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit rel when the relationship does not need to be declared.
properties.description: Optional native relationship tokens. Include noopener when opening an untrusted destination in a new browsing context.

properties.name: currentPage
properties.description: Marks this destination as the current page without introducing a separate visual variant.

accessibility: Use anchors with href for navigation.
Make link text meaningful outside its immediate visual context.
Allow long localized or unbroken destination labels to wrap without clipping or horizontal overflow.
Honor reduced-motion preferences for decorative color and underline transitions.
Use rel="noopener" for untrusted new-tab destinations when appropriate.
Use aria-current="page" only for the link whose destination represents the current page.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css.
